title: DEF Dosing Valve Mechanical Fault
shortDescription: DEF dosing valve is not responding to commanded flow, ECM detects mechanical failure.
fullDescription:
PACCAR MX-13 and MX-11 SCR systems use a Bosch dosing module. When commanded DEF flow does not produce expected pressure drop in the rail, the ECM logs P1C4D / SPN 5394 FMI 7.

Usually crystallized DEF inside the doser tip or a stuck plunger. Triggers escalating inducement: yellow lamp, derate, and ultimately 5 mph speed limit.

causes.cause: Crystallized DEF in dosing valve tip

fixSteps.title: Run DEF dosing test in DAVIE4
fixSteps.instruction: Use PACCAR DAVIE4 to command dosing, observe pressure drop and audible click.

fixSteps.title: Remove and inspect dosing valve
fixSteps.instruction: Unbolt from SCR inlet, clean crystallized DEF with warm water, inspect tip.

fixSteps.title: Replace dosing valve assembly
fixSteps.instruction: Install new Bosch dosing module with new gasket, torque to 10 Nm.

fixSteps.title: Reset adaptations
fixSteps.instruction: Use DAVIE4 to reset SCR adaptations and force regen.

whenToCallPro: DAVIE4 is required to reset adaptations after replacement.
videoSearchQuery: PACCAR MX-13 P1C4D dosing valve fix

faq.q: Will warm water actually clean it?
faq.a: Yes, urea is water-soluble. Soak the doser tip in 50C water for 15 minutes.

title: SCR NOx Catalyst Efficiency Below Threshold
shortDescription: Outlet NOx sensor reports too much NOx leaving the SCR catalyst.
fullDescription:
ECM compares inlet vs outlet NOx readings. P20EE sets when conversion efficiency drops below the EPA threshold (typically 70 percent).

Root causes range from out-of-spec DEF, failed NOx sensors, sulfated catalyst, or excessive exhaust leaks before the outlet sensor.

fixSteps.title: Verify DEF quality
fixSteps.instruction: Use refractometer, must read 32.5 percent urea.

fixSteps.title: Inspect for exhaust leaks
fixSteps.instruction: Check V-band clamps and gaskets between turbo and SCR outlet.

fixSteps.title: Replace NOx sensors
fixSteps.instruction: Replace outlet first, retest. If still failing, replace inlet. Use 22 mm NOx socket.

fixSteps.title: Run SCR efficiency test
fixSteps.instruction: Use DAVIE4 to run efficiency test after parked regen.

whenToCallPro: If NOx sensors and DEF quality are good, catalyst replacement is a dealer job.
videoSearchQuery: PACCAR MX-13 P20EE NOx sensor replacement

faq.a: Outlet NOx sensor fails 3x more often than inlet on MX engines.

title: DEF Quality Performance
shortDescription: Reductant quality below required performance level.
fullDescription:
Set when SCR cannot achieve target NOx reduction with normal dosing. The ECM concludes DEF is contaminated or diluted.

Long derate timeline: warning, then 25 percent torque reduction, then 5 mph speed limit per EPA inducement schedule.

causes.cause: DEF tank contamination from prior fill

fixSteps.title: Test DEF with refractometer
fixSteps.instruction: Should read 32.5 percent urea. Off means drain and refill.

fixSteps.title: Drain DEF tank
fixSteps.instruction: Remove drain plug or pump out, dispose properly.

fixSteps.title: Refill with fresh ISO 22241 DEF
fixSteps.instruction: Use only API-certified DEF, fill to full.

fixSteps.title: Clear codes and run regen
fixSteps.instruction: Clear with DAVIE4, run drive cycle to confirm.

whenToCallPro: If quality remains flagged after a clean refill, NOx sensor or catalyst diagnosis needed.

faq.a: Common cause. Always refill from sealed jugs or trusted bulk dispensers.

title: DPF Regeneration Frequency Excessive
shortDescription: Active regenerations are occurring more often than expected.
fullDescription:
MX engines log frequency of active regens. P2459 sets when regens occur too close together, indicating excess soot production from poor combustion or short-trip duty.

Possible upstream causes: leaking injector, charge air leak, EGR sticking open, fuel doser dripping.

fixSteps.title: Pressure-test charge air system
fixSteps.instruction: Pressurize to 25 psi, listen for hisses or use soapy water.

fixSteps.title: Run injector return flow test
fixSteps.instruction: Use DAVIE4 to balance test cylinders. Remove and bench-test high-return injectors.

fixSteps.title: Inspect EGR valve operation
fixSteps.instruction: Command EGR open/close in DAVIE4, verify smooth motion.

fixSteps.title: Replace failed component
fixSteps.instruction: Replace leaking injector, EGR valve, or charge cooler as identified.

whenToCallPro: Injector diagnosis requires bench equipment and trim coding.

faq.a: Yes. Engines below 60 mph for hours rarely passive-regen and rely on actives.

title: Turbocharger Underboost
shortDescription: Boost pressure is below commanded value.
fullDescription:
MX-13 uses a VGT turbo with electronic actuator. P0299 sets when measured boost falls short of demand. Could be sticking VGT vanes from soot, leaking charge air pipes, or actuator failure.

Results in low power, smoke, and missed regen targets.

fixSteps.title: Pressure test charge air
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm no hose leaks under 25 psi.

fixSteps.title: Run VGT calibration
fixSteps.instruction: DAVIE4 VGT actuator test, watch sweep duty 0-100 percent.

fixSteps.title: Free or replace VGT
fixSteps.instruction: Soot-stuck vanes may free with regen and BG-244, otherwise turbo replacement.

fixSteps.title: Replace VGT actuator
fixSteps.instruction: If turbo body OK but actuator dead, swap actuator and recalibrate.

whenToCallPro: Turbo replacement on MX-13 is a dealer-level job, oil supply lines and gaskets are critical.
videoSearchQuery: PACCAR MX P0299 underboost VGT fix

faq.q: Will running the engine hard help?
faq.a: An Italian tune-up sometimes frees soot-stuck vanes, but only if the actuator works.

title: Fuel Rail Pressure Too Low
shortDescription: High-pressure fuel rail cannot reach commanded pressure.
fullDescription:
Common rail pressure must hit 1800-2400 bar on MX engines. P0087 sets when actual lags target by more than 15 percent.

Usually caused by plugged filters, failing high-pressure pump, leaking injectors returning excess fuel, or bad rail pressure sensor.

fixSteps.title: Replace fuel filters and prime
fixSteps.instruction: New primary + secondary, prime via hand pump.

fixSteps.title: Run leak-back test on injectors
fixSteps.instruction: Cap returns, measure with graduated cylinders during cranking.

fixSteps.title: Test rail pressure with DAVIE4
fixSteps.instruction: Crank and observe actual pressure; below 250 bar at crank means pump or sensor issue.

fixSteps.title: Replace HP pump if confirmed
fixSteps.instruction: Drain, remove, install new pump with new gasket and torque spec.

whenToCallPro: HP pump removal requires special pulley puller and TDC alignment.
videoSearchQuery: PACCAR MX P0087 low rail pressure

faq.q: Could it be water in fuel?
faq.a: Yes. Drain water separator first, water can damage HP pump in minutes.

title: EGR Insufficient Flow
shortDescription: EGR system cannot achieve commanded flow.
fullDescription:
MX engines monitor commanded vs actual EGR mass flow. P0401 sets when actual is too low for too long. Causes include carbon-clogged EGR valve, plugged cooler, or stuck actuator.

Leads to high NOx emissions and potential SCR fault.

fixSteps.title: Command EGR test in DAVIE4
fixSteps.instruction: Sweep 0-100 percent, watch position vs commanded.

fixSteps.title: Remove and clean EGR valve
fixSteps.instruction: Unbolt, soak in carb cleaner, scrub carbon from butterfly.

fixSteps.title: Inspect EGR cooler
fixSteps.instruction: Look through ports for soot blockage. Replace if heavily plugged.

fixSteps.title: Replace EGR cooler if blocked
fixSteps.instruction: Major coolant drain and removal job.

whenToCallPro: EGR cooler replacement requires coolant fill, vacuum bleed.

faq.q: Can I block off the EGR?
faq.a: No, this is illegal in the US/Canada and triggers more faults.

title: DPF Efficiency Below Threshold
shortDescription: Diesel particulate filter is not capturing particulates as expected.
fullDescription:
MX engines use delta-P and PM sensor data to validate DPF integrity. P2002 sets when the filter appears to be passing too much soot - cracked substrate, melted from over-temp regen, or removed.

Replacement of the DPF is typical, after confirming with a back-pressure test.

fixSteps.title: Verify with delta-P test
fixSteps.instruction: DAVIE4 reads near-zero delta-P at high RPM means failed filter.

fixSteps.title: Inspect DPF visually
fixSteps.instruction: Remove, look into face cells for cracks, melt holes, or missing substrate.

fixSteps.title: Replace DPF assembly
fixSteps.instruction: Install OEM DPF, new gaskets and clamps, reset DPF service in DAVIE4.

whenToCallPro: DPF replacement is dealer-level due to programming and EPA compliance.

faq.a: Cracked filters cannot be cleaned, only replaced.

title: Mass Air Flow Sensor Range/Performance
shortDescription: MAF sensor reading is implausible compared to other engine inputs.
fullDescription:
MX-13 cross-checks MAF against MAP and turbo speed. P0101 sets when readings disagree.

Dirty hot-wire element, soot contamination from CCV mist, or unmetered air leaks are the typical causes.

fixSteps.title: Inspect air filter housing
fixSteps.instruction: Check for oil mist downstream of CCV.

fixSteps.title: Clean MAF sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Remove, spray with MAF-safe cleaner only, air dry.

fixSteps.title: Replace MAF sensor
fixSteps.instruction: If cleaning does not resolve, install new sensor.

fixSteps.title: Inspect CCV
fixSteps.instruction: Replace plugged crankcase breather element to stop oil contamination.

whenToCallPro: Rare, this is a DIY-friendly fault.

faq.a: Yes, but only MAF-specific spray; brake cleaner damages the hot-wire.

title: EGR Temperature Sensor Low Voltage
shortDescription: EGR temperature sensor signal is shorted low.
fullDescription:
EGR temp sensor monitors gas temp entering the intake. FMI 4 voltage below normal indicates a short to ground or open ground.

ECM substitutes default and may disable EGR, leading to additional emission codes.

fixSteps.title: Inspect connector
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect, inspect for corrosion or pin push-out.

fixSteps.title: Resistance check sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Compare to spec at known temperature, NTC type.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Unscrew from EGR cooler outlet, install new with anti-seize.

whenToCallPro: Only if harness damage extends into the engine bay loom.
videoSearchQuery: PACCAR MX P040C EGR temp sensor

faq.a: Yes, but EGR is disabled and emissions go out of spec.
